A robot program failed to move "blue_book" (kind: book) onto "orange_tray".

go_home()
obs = observe()
blue_book_candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_book")
candidate = blue_book_candidates[0]  # Use first candidate
grasp(candidate)
wait(20)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp blue_book")
spots = free_spots("orange_tray")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
wait(20)
lower_until_contact()
wait(20)
open_gripper()
wait(20)
retreat(dz=0.12)
wait(20)
check_result = check("blue_book", "orange_tray")
if not check_result["satisfied"]:
    raise RuntimeError("blue_book not correctly placed on orange_tray")

- The fingertip line (yaw) was 90 degrees from the object's long axis, so the fingers squeezed across a 0.055 m extent of the object (the open fingers are 0.08 m apart; footprint is 0.073 along long_axis_yaw x 0.055 along short_axis_yaw).
- After the program the camera could not see blue_book or orange_tray.
Object as seen by the camera: {"height": 0.025, "top_z": 0.8249, "footprint_long": 0.0732, "footprint_short": 0.0549, "long_axis_yaw": 0.5, "short_axis_yaw": -1.071}
